headline: Fronts Ignite as Bases Change Hands Across Theater
war_summary: Since the 18:05 edition the war has entered a sharper phase of base turnover. Fishermans Row remains the hottest sector, logging eight ownership flips in the last two hours and twenty‑six in the day, pushing Colonial and Warden casualties to roughly 280 and 300 per hour respectively. Linn Mercy continues its frenetic pace with three fresh captures in two hours and thirty‑two total, driving both sides’ loss rates above 250 per hour. New pressure appeared at Godcrofts (three captures at 20:15), Lykos Isle (two flips at the filing time) and Stlican Shelf (two captures at 20:30), each showing accelerating casualty trends. Dead Lands, while still costly, has cooled to five daily captures with casualty rates near 1,600 (Warden) and 1,100 (Colonial) per hour. Endless Shore’s intense fighting has eased markedly, its hourly losses dropping to single digits after a day of nineteen captures. Kings Cage, Oarbreaker and Stonecradle retain modest activity but no fresh two‑hour events. The majority of rear‑area hexes report static ownership and flat casualty curves.
